meta.description: PriceAI compares your grocery prices with Bulgarian retail chains every day, matches products with AI and tells you where to raise, lower or hold.

dashboard.title: Your prices today
dashboard.intro: How your catalog compares with competitor prices collected daily.
dashboard.staleBanner: These competitor prices are from {date}. The daily update hasn’t run since, so check them before you change a price.

hints.at-risk: More than {pct} above the cheapest chain
hints.opportunity: Cheapest by more than {pct}, room to raise
hints.unmatched: No chain sells it yet, or matching is pending

dashboard.emptyText: Add your products one by one or import your price list as a CSV file.

bulk.title: Apply suggested prices
bulk.help: Each ticked product gets its suggested price, worked out from today’s competitor prices. Prices below your cost start unticked.
bulk.applied: {n} new prices applied. Update them in your till or POS too.

export.title: Export changed prices
export.help: Download every product whose price you changed in PriceAI since a date, as a CSV file with the same columns as the import. Load it into your till or POS so your shelf prices match.

home.eyebrow: AI price intelligence for Bulgarian grocers
title: Compete Smarter.
Price Better.
home.lead: PriceAI reads the prices of {count} Bulgarian chains every night, matches them to your catalog product by product and tells you where to raise, lower or hold.

scan.label: Example price scan for one product
scan.ai: Hold at {price}. You stay below every tracked chain and keep your margin.

features.title: Everything you need to price with confidence
features.text: Built for Bulgarian grocery merchants: track, match and act on competitor prices without checking shelves by hand.

items.title: AI product matching
items.text: A keyword search shortlists listings, then Gemini confirms it is the same product by name, brand and size.

items.title: Price statuses
items.text: Every product is labelled competitive, opportunity, at risk or unmatched, so you know where to look first.

items.title: Daily scans
items.text: Prices come from the feeds large chains must publish by law, refreshed before 07:00 every morning.

items.title: Price history
items.text: Every run is kept, so you can see how your price and the market moved over weeks and months.

tracker.title: Your command center for pricing
tracker.text: Track every product, compare it with the best market price and filter to what needs attention.

insights.title: Turn price changes into margin
insights.text: PriceAI does not just show you the market. It tells you what to do about it.

chart.title: Price trend
chart.subtitle: 6 months · your price vs. market average
chart.label: Line chart: your price rose from April to September and is now {yours}, while the market average is {market}.

insights.heading: AI insights

items.title: Price recommendation
items.text: {product} is {pct} above the market. Lower it to {price} to move back into the competitive band.

items.title: New match found
items.text: Chicken fillet 1 kg now matches a {chain} listing at {match}, 2% below your price.

items.title: Unmatched product
items.text: {count} product in your catalog has no competitor match yet. Add a brand or size to help the AI.

reports.title: Your whole catalog in one weekly report
reports.text: See which products lose you sales, where you can raise prices and how well each chain covers your range.
reports.note: Example data from a sample catalog.

how.title: From raw feeds to smarter prices
how.text: No technical setup. Add your products and the pipeline does the rest overnight.

steps.title: Add your products
steps.text: Enter each product with its name, price and optional brand and size. More detail means better matches.

steps.title: We collect prices
steps.text: Every night we read the official price feeds that large chains must publish by law.

steps.title: AI matches them
steps.text: A keyword search shortlists listings, then Gemini confirms which one is the same product.

steps.title: You act on it
steps.text: Each product gets a status and shows up in your reports, so you know what to reprice today.

final.title: Know where you stand against the market
final.text: Create an account, add your products or import your price list and see how every price compares with the chains.
points: Alerts when a chain undercuts you

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.text: Your price is in line with the market.

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.text: You are cheaper than competitors and have room to raise the price.

at-risk.name: At risk
at-risk.text: Competitors sell the same product for less.

unmatched.name: Unmatched
unmatched.text: No competitor listing matched this product yet.

footer.tagline: AI price intelligence for Bulgarian grocers. Your catalog against every major chain, every morning.

auth.signInIntro: Sign in to see where your prices stand this morning.
auth.signUpIntro: Add your catalog and see how every product compares with the chains.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetIntro: You'll go straight to your dashboard after saving it.

notices.checkEmail: Check your inbox and open the confirmation link to finish creating your account.
notices.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.

errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first. The link is in your inbox.
errors.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.over_email_send_rate_limit: Too many emails sent. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.over_request_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.link: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one or sign in again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.same_password: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.username: Choose a username of 2 to 32 characters.

products.confirmDelete: Delete this product and its price history?

notices.added: Product added. AI is looking for it at competitor chains; its row updates when it finishes.
notices.priceApplied: New price applied. Your status is updated.

errors.name: Enter a product name.
errors.price: Enter a price above zero, like 1,79.
errors.cost: Enter a cost price like 1,35, or leave it empty.
errors.sku_taken: Another product already uses this SKU.
errors.too_big: The file is larger than 4 MB. Split it into smaller files.
errors.columns: The file needs a header row with these columns: {cols}.
errors.empty: No product in the file could be imported.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

import.title: Import a price list
import.help: A CSV file with a header row: name and price are required, brand, size, sku and cost are optional. Comma or semicolon separators and decimal commas both work, so you can save straight from Excel. Products are matched by SKU, or by name, brand and size.

suggest.title: Possible matches
suggest.help: We couldn’t confirm these listings are your product, often because the name leaves out a detail such as fat % or pack size. Use the ones that are the same product and their prices count towards your status. Adding the missing detail to the name also lets matching find it on its own.

page.noDetails: No brand, size or SKU yet
page.lowerWhy: {chain} sells it for {best}. You are {gap} ({pct}) more expensive, so shoppers comparing prices may go there.
page.raiseWhy: You are the cheapest by a wide margin. At this price you still undercut {chain} ({best}) and earn {gain} more on every unit.
page.promo: The cheapest price is a promotion, so it may not last.
page.promoUntil: The cheapest price is a promotion until {date}. Consider changing back after it ends.
page.competitive: Your price is competitive. The cheapest chain, {chain}, sells it for {best}. Nothing to change today.
page.reviewMatches: No confirmed competitor prices yet. Review the possible matches below: each one you accept adds its price.
page.nothing: No suggestions yet. No chain lists this product, or matching hasn’t run. Adding brand and pack size helps matching find it.
page.noCost: Add your cost price to see it
page.belowCost: At {price} you would lose {loss} on every unit (cost {cost}).
page.pending: Matching is pending. Competitor prices appear here once it runs.
page.matching: AI is looking for this product at competitor chains. This page updates when it finishes.

trend.title: Price trend
trend.subtitle: Weekly · your price vs. the average of the matched chains
trend.label: Line chart of your price and the market average by week. Your price is now {yours}, the market average {market}.

limits.step: Your pricing rules allow a {pct} change per step, so this is one step of the way.

page.held: {chain} sells it for {best}, but lowering your price would take your margin below your {pct} minimum, so there’s no suggestion.

rules.title: Pricing rules
rules.intro: Every suggested price, on the dashboard and on each product, follows these rules. Leave a field empty to switch that rule off.

fields.undercut: Go under the cheapest chain by (€)

hints.min_margin: Never suggest a price with a lower gross margin. Needs a cost price on the product.
hints.undercut: 0 or empty matches the cheapest price. When raising, it’s at least one cent under.
hints.max_change: Big moves are split into steps, so shoppers don’t see a sudden jump.

errors.undercut: Enter an amount from 0 to 100, like 0,05.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: How your prices are trending, what moved at the chains and where to look first.

index.title: Price index
index.subtitle: Weekly · 100 = the chains’ average price for your products
index.label: Line chart of your price index by week. Your index is now {yours}, the market is {market}.

changes.title: Your price changes · last {days} days
changes.bySource: {apply} from suggestions · {manual} by hand · {csv} from CSV imports
changes.none: You haven’t changed a price in the last {days} days.
changes.noneApplied: Apply a suggested price on a product page

reports.indexStarting: Your price index is {index} today (100 = the chains’ average price). The chart fills in with each new day of prices.
reports.noMoves: No price moves at the chains in the latest daily prices
reports.noneRisk: Nothing at risk. None of your prices is above the cheapest chain.
reports.noneOpportunity: No opportunities right now. None of your prices is well below the cheapest chain.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing new yet. When a chain undercuts you, starts or ends a promo, or stops listing one of your products, it shows up here each morning.
notifications.intro: What changed at the chains for your products, newest first. New notifications arrive each morning with the daily prices.
